did.description: DID to be assigned. Defaults to the caller's DID. Admins may assign to any moderator.

queueId.description: Optional queue ID to associate the assignment with. If not provided and the report has been assigned on a queue before, it will stay on that queue.

reportId.description: The ID of the report to assign.

isPermanent.description: When true, the assignment has no expiry (endAt is null). Throws AlreadyAssigned if another user already has a permanent assignment on this report.

errors.name: AlreadyAssigned
errors.description: The report is already assigned to another user.

errors.name: InvalidAssignment
errors.description: The report ID or queue ID is invalid.

main.description: Assign a report to a user. Defaults to the caller. Admins may assign to any moderator.
